acceptance_profile.health_authority: Compose over Character-Actors, Condition and ICF owner state by stable reference; DPL-05 may define profiles/rules and orchestration contracts but must not create a competing universal Character/Condition/health ledger.
acceptance_profile.diagnosis_treatment: Represent authored diagnosis, treatment and procedure definitions with explicit source/provenance, setting/profile, capability, equipment/facility and consent/privacy references; no universal real-world medical claims may be inferred from incomplete game sources.
acceptance_profile.disease_progression: Represent authored incubation, stage/progression, exposure/transmission, resistance/immunity and resolution references only where sources/profiles define them; setting-sensitive disease content must never become globally mandatory.
acceptance_profile.poison_progression: Consume DPL-04 toxicology delivery/effect handoffs and model authored exposure, repeated-save/dose/decay/recovery/stacking behavior only where governed game sources define it; do not invent pharmacokinetic or real-world toxicology formulas.
acceptance_profile.injury_recovery: Represent authored injury, lasting-effect, treatment, rest, rehabilitation and recovery Projects while Character/Condition owners retain live state and APW/D26 owns time/progress orchestration.
acceptance_profile.consent_privacy: Procedures, invasive treatment and sensitive health projections must preserve explicit character/player/GM/setting consent and visibility/privacy owner references; no automatic irreversible body/identity mutation.
acceptance_profile.boundaries: No DPL-06+ extraction/industry/business mechanics, no duplicate Character/Condition/ICF/Project/Asset ledger, no real-money commerce and no migration 0022 without demonstrated durable schema delta.
acceptance_profile.validation: Focused DPL-05 verifier plus exact-head repository health and governed Linux/Windows deterministic Validation Core must pass before merge.

nonauthorization: automatic irreversible medical/body/identity mutation or consent bypass
universal real-world medical, disease or toxicology formulas inferred from incomplete game sources
